tvShow.name: Trigger Point
tvShow.overview: For London's bomb disposal experts, no day is ever the same as they risk their lives protecting the city from harm.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Bomb disposal officers Lana Washington and Joel Nutkins are called out to a Met counter-terrorism operation at a London housing estate to investigate a potential bomb factory and suspected bomb-maker Andy Phelan.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: As the bombing campaign intensifies, so do inter-community tensions as the far-right group English Flag take to the streets to blame Islamists for the attack.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: A far-right group called the Crusaders claim responsibility for the mosque attack. Lana finds a forensic link between the bomb at the mosque and the one at Westhaven - were they both bombed by the same person?

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Following the murder of a Counter Terrorism officer, Lana Washington and the EXPO team race against time to stop the bombers before they strike again.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Lana struggles to come to terms with her personal loss, and her failure to prevent the explosion. Meanwhile, Counter Terrorism officers identify the bomber and launch a massive manhunt.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: The EXPO team are stretched to breaking point dealing with a complicated device planted at the Campaign HQ of the Progressive Alliance. Lana tells Karl she wants to break up.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Expo Lana Washington is giving a routine talk, having just returned from secondment, when an explosion rocks the heart of the city. But is she ready to return to active duty?

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: The police launch an investigation to find the bombers, whose skill and sophistication keeps them one step ahead. Under pressure to get results, Helen makes a breakthrough.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: As the team mourns Thom's death, a new lead emerges - an informant, promising intelligence on the terror cell. Meanwhile a journalist is sent a suspicious package.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Alex contacts the police with critical information about a new attack planned for that day, but Commander Francis warns the team against placing too much trust in him.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Lana breaks protocol to try to help Alex, knowing he has nobody else to turn to. Then the team makes a shock discovery about the terror cell they’re tracking down.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Lana is faced with an impossible decision when she is kidnapped by the terror cell. A choice between her duty and saving those who matter the most to her.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Lana and her team are called in to investigate a London black cab that has been abandoned in a wasteland - and soon realise that something more sinister is going on.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Counter Terrorism Police work to establish a link between the victims of the incidents, but a well-meaning intervention backfires and leaves the unit at a loss.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Counter Terrorism Command learn more about the recent murders with the help of Lana, but their progress doesn't go unnoticed by the bomber as their campaign deepens.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: All hope looks lost for the remaining missing person until a new lead emerges - with Lana now known to the bomber, she must work harder than ever to avoid his traps.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: The bomber's next target is symbolic of their whole campaign as Lana, who is rushing against the clock, must find the bomb in a search held amidst pandemonium.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: After one last attack, Lana faces a reckoning when she uncovers the truth behind the campaign as the confession so desperately fought for finally comes.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Explosives officer Lana Washington and her bomb-disposal team track a suspicious lorry through London as they work against the clock to make sure it does not reach its destination.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Lana and her team spring into action after the previous attack, with clues leading them to a boatyard, but the bombers stay one step ahead...

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: From Lana's hard work, Counter Terror are able to make a breakthrough - sending Lana and her team to a disused workshop to find any information they can on the bombers' next steps.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: With talks of a possible catastrophe to come, Lana and her team are on edge as they are directed to an airfield.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: When a colleague's life is in danger, Lana and the team do all they can to rescue them as Counter Terror race to uncover the true identity of the bombers.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: The final showdown forces Lana into a life-or-death situation as she races against the clock to save thousands of lives.
